```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{inline_data_media: "AltTextOnly", tier_strategy: "Auto"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert_with_accessible_names("<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\">GitHub<svg aria-label=\"(opens in new tab)\"><use href=\"\#ext\"></use></svg></a> now</p>", true, options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
